name: geoaiworkbench
description: Controlled empirical comparison of three paradigms for LLM-driven GIS automation
//workspaces: Members are the Python packages plus the agent-tooling façades. `python` itself is listed explicitly as well as globbed: `python/*` matches `python/geoai-core` and its siblings but NOT `python/package.json`, and the container package is the one whose `turbo.json` turns caching off for all three. Without the explicit entry the nested config is silently dead. There is no TypeScript source yet, so nothing needs a `typecheck`; turbo skips a task a package does not declare, and the seam is where the first TS package lands. `opencode-ai` is deliberately NOT a dependency: it is a CLI installed globally by `pixi run opencode-install`, and a copy in node_modules is a second version nobody would run.
